  simp only [Walk.isCycle_def, Ne] at hc
  cases c with
  | nil => cases hc.2.1 rfl

    simp only [Walk.isTrail_cons, Walk.support_cons, List.tail_cons] at hc
    specialize h _ _ ⟨c', by simp only [Walk.isPath_def, hc.2]⟩ (Path.singleton ha.symm)

  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  simp only [← (set_fintype_card_eq_univ_iff _).mpr G.iUnion_connectedComponentSupp,

theorem edges_dropUntil_subset {u v w : V} (p : G.Walk v w) (h : u ∈ p.support) :

lemma snd_takeUntil (hsu : w ≠ u) (p : G.Walk u v) (h : w ∈ p.support) :

    (p.takeUntil w hw).takeUntil x hx = p.takeUntil x (p.support_takeUntil_subset hw hx) := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.rotate_darts
header:
theorem rotate_darts (c : G.Walk v v) (u : V) (h) : (c.rotate u h).darts ~r c.darts := by
  simp only [rotate, darts_append]
  apply List.IsRotated.trans List.isRotated_append
  rw [← darts_append, take_spec]

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.rotate_edges
header:
theorem rotate_edges (c : G.Walk v v) (u : V) (h) : (c.rotate u h).edges ~r c.edges :=
  (rotate_darts c u h).map _

/-- Given a walk `p` and a node in the support, there exists a natural `n`, such that given node
is the `n`-th node (zero-indexed) in the walk. In addition, `n` is at most the length of the walk.
Due to the definition of `getVert` it would otherwise be legal to return a larger `n` for the last
node. -/

name: mem_support_iff_exists_getVert
header:
theorem mem_support_iff_exists_getVert {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk v w} :
    u ∈ p.support ↔ ∃ n, p.getVert n = u ∧ n ≤ p.length := by

name: SimpleGraph.induce_nil

lemma isSubwalk_nil_iff {u v u'} (p : G.Walk u v) :
    p.IsSubwalk (nil : G.Walk u' u') ↔ ∃ (hu : u' = u) (hv : u' = v), p = nil.copy hu hv := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.nil_isSubwalk_iff_exists
header:
lemma nil_isSubwalk_iff_exists {u' u v} (q : G.Walk u v) :
    (Walk.nil : G.Walk u' u').IsSubwalk q ↔
      ∃ (ru : G.Walk u u') (rv : G.Walk u' v), q = ru.append rv := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.length_le_of_isSubwalk
header:
lemma length_le_of_isSubwalk {u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂} {q : G.Walk u₁ v₁} {p : G.Walk u₂ v₂}
    (h : p.IsSubwalk q) : p.length ≤ q.length := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_of_append_left
header:
lemma isSubwalk_of_append_left {v w u : V} {p₁ : G.Walk v w} {p₂ : G.Walk w u} {p₃ : G.Walk v u}
    (h : p₃ = p₁.append p₂) : p₁.IsSubwalk p₃ :=

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_of_append_right
header:
lemma isSubwalk_of_append_right {v w u : V} {p₁ : G.Walk v w} {p₂ : G.Walk w u} {p₃ : G.Walk v u}
    (h : p₃ = p₁.append p₂) : p₂.IsSubwalk p₃ :=

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_take
header:
theorem isSubwalk_take {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (n : ℕ) : (p.take n).IsSubwalk p :=
  ⟨nil, p.drop n, by simp⟩

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_drop
header:
theorem isSubwalk_drop {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (n : ℕ) : (p.drop n).IsSubwalk p :=
  ⟨p.take n, nil, by simp⟩

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_iff_support_isInfix
header:
theorem isSubwalk_iff_support_isInfix {v w v' w' : V} {p₁ : G.Walk v w} {p₂ : G.Walk v' w'} :
    p₁.IsSubwalk p₂ ↔ p₁.support <:+: p₂.support := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_iff_darts_isInfix
header:
theorem isSubwalk_iff_darts_isInfix {p₁ : G.Walk u v} {p₂ : G.Walk u' v'} (hnil : ¬p₁.Nil) :
    p₁.IsSubwalk p₂ ↔ p₁.darts <:+: p₂.darts := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_nil_iff_mem_support
header:
theorem isSubwalk_nil_iff_mem_support (p : G.Walk u v) :
    (nil : G.Walk v' v').IsSubwalk p ↔ v' ∈ p.support :=

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_toWalk_iff_mem_darts
header:
theorem isSubwalk_toWalk_iff_mem_darts (p : G.Walk u v) (h : G.Adj u' v') :
    h.toWalk.IsSubwalk p ↔ ⟨⟨u', v'⟩, h⟩ ∈ p.darts := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_toWalk_adj_iff_mem_darts
header:
theorem isSubwalk_toWalk_adj_iff_mem_darts {d : G.Dart} (p : G.Walk u v) :
    d.adj.toWalk.IsSubwalk p ↔ d ∈ p.darts :=

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_toWalk_iff_mem_edges
header:
theorem isSubwalk_toWalk_iff_mem_edges {p : G.Walk u v} (h : G.Adj u' v') :
    h.toWalk.IsSubwalk p ∨ h.symm.toWalk.IsSubwalk p ↔ s(u', v') ∈ p.edges := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.infix_support_iff_mem_edges
header:
theorem infix_support_iff_mem_edges {p : G.Walk u v} :
    [u', v'] <:+: p.support ∨ [v', u'] <:+: p.support ↔ s(u', v') ∈ p.edges := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.isSubwalk_antisymm
header:
lemma isSubwalk_antisymm {u v} {p₁ p₂ : G.Walk u v} (h₁ : p₁.IsSubwalk p₂) (h₂ : p₂.IsSubwalk p₁) :
    p₁ = p₂ := by

theorem IsSubwalk.edges_isInfix {u v u' v' : V} {p₁ : G.Walk u v} {p₂ : G.Walk u' v'}

theorem take_isSubwalk_take {u v n k} (p : G.Walk u v) (h : n ≤ k) :

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero
header:
theorem getVert_zero {u v} (w : G.Walk u v) : w.getVert 0 = u := by cases w <;> rfl

@[simp]

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_of_length_le
header:
theorem getVert_of_length_le {u v} (w : G.Walk u v) {i : ℕ} (hi : w.length ≤ i) :
    w.getVert i = v := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_length
header:
theorem getVert_length {u v} (w : G.Walk u v) : w.getVert w.length = v :=
  w.getVert_of_length_le rfl.le

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.adj_getVert_succ
header:
theorem adj_getVert_succ {u v} (w : G.Walk u v) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < w.length) :
    G.Adj (w.getVert i) (w.getVert (i + 1)) := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_cons_succ
header:
lemma getVert_cons_succ {u v w n} (p : G.Walk v w) (h : G.Adj u v) :
    (p.cons h).getVert (n + 1) = p.getVert n := rfl

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_cons
header:
lemma getVert_cons {u v w n} (p : G.Walk v w) (h : G.Adj u v) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (p.cons h).getVert n = p.getVert (n - 1) := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_mem_support
header:
theorem getVert_mem_support {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (i : ℕ) : p.getVert i ∈ p.support := by
  induction p generalizing i <;> cases i <;> simp [*]

/-- Use `support_getElem_eq_getVert` to rewrite in the reverse direction. -/

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_eq_support_getElem
header:
lemma getVert_eq_support_getElem {u v : V} {n : ℕ} (p : G.Walk u v) (h : n ≤ p.length) :
    p.getVert n = p.support[n]'(p.length_support ▸ Nat.lt_add_one_of_le h) := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.support_getElem_eq_getVert
header:
lemma support_getElem_eq_getVert {u v : V} {n : ℕ} (p : G.Walk u v) (h) :
    p.support[n]'h = p.getVert n :=

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_eq_support_getElem
header:
lemma getVert_eq_support_getElem? {u v : V} {n : ℕ} (p : G.Walk u v) (h : n ≤ p.length) :
    some (p.getVert n) = p.support[n]? := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_eq_getD_support
header:
lemma getVert_eq_getD_support {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (n : ℕ) :
    p.getVert n = p.support.getD n v := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_support_idxOf
header:
lemma getVert_support_idxOf [DecidableEq V] (p : G.Walk u v) (h : w ∈ p.support) :
    p.getVert (p.support.idxOf w) = w := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_comp_val_eq_get_support
header:
theorem getVert_comp_val_eq_get_support {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) :
    p.getVert ∘ Fin.val = p.support.get := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.range_getVert_eq_range_support_getElem
header:
theorem range_getVert_eq_range_support_getElem {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) :
    Set.range p.getVert = Set.range p.support.get :=

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.darts_getElem_eq_getVert
header:
theorem darts_getElem_eq_getVert {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} (n : ℕ) (h : n < p.darts.length) :
    p.darts[n] = ⟨⟨p.getVert n, p.getVert (n + 1)⟩, p.adj_getVert_succ (p.length_darts ▸ h)⟩ := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.adj_of_infix_support
header:
theorem adj_of_infix_support {u v u' v'} {p : G.Walk u v} (h : [u', v'] <:+: p.support) :
    G.Adj u' v' := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.adj_snd
header:
@[simp] lemma adj_snd {p : G.Walk v w} (hp : ¬ p.Nil) :
    G.Adj v p.snd := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.snd_cons
header:
lemma snd_cons {u v w} (q : G.Walk v w) (hadj : G.Adj u v) :
    (q.cons hadj).snd = v := by simp

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.snd_mem_tail_support
header:
lemma snd_mem_tail_support {u v : V} {p : G.Walk u v} (h : ¬p.Nil) : p.snd ∈ p.support.tail :=
  p.notNilRec (by simp) h

@[simp]

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.support_getElem_one
header:
lemma support_getElem_one {p : G.Walk u v} (hp) : p.support[1]'hp = p.snd := by
  grind [getVert_eq_support_getElem]

/-- Use `support_getElem_one` to rewrite in the reverse direction. -/

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.snd_eq_support_getElem_one
header:
lemma snd_eq_support_getElem_one {p : G.Walk u v} (hnil : ¬p.Nil) :
    p.snd = p.support[1]'(by grind [not_nil_iff_lt_length]) :=

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.penultimate_cons_nil
header:
lemma penultimate_cons_nil (h : G.Adj u v) : (cons h nil).penultimate = u := rfl

@[simp]

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.penultimate_cons_cons
header:
lemma penultimate_cons_cons {w'} (h : G.Adj u v) (h₂ : G.Adj v w) (p : G.Walk w w') :
    (cons h (cons h₂ p)).penultimate = (cons h₂ p).penultimate := rfl

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.penultimate_cons_of_not_nil
header:
lemma penultimate_cons_of_not_nil (h : G.Adj u v) (p : G.Walk v w) (hp : ¬ p.Nil) :
    (cons h p).penultimate = p.penultimate :=

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.adj_penultimate
header:
lemma adj_penultimate {p : G.Walk v w} (hp : ¬ p.Nil) :
    G.Adj p.penultimate w := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.penultimate_mem_dropLast_support
header:
lemma penultimate_mem_dropLast_support {p : G.Walk u v} (h : ¬p.Nil) :
    p.penultimate ∈ p.support.dropLast := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.support_getElem_length_sub_one_eq_penultimate
header:
lemma support_getElem_length_sub_one_eq_penultimate {p : G.Walk u v} :
    p.support[p.length - 1] = p.penultimate := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.edge_firstDart
header:
lemma edge_firstDart (p : G.Walk v w) (hp : ¬ p.Nil) :
    (p.firstDart hp).edge = s(v, p.snd) := rfl

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.edge_lastDart
header:
lemma edge_lastDart (p : G.Walk v w) (hp : ¬ p.Nil) :
    (p.lastDart hp).edge = s(p.penultimate, w) := rfl

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.firstDart_eq
header:
theorem firstDart_eq {p : G.Walk v w} (h₁ : ¬ p.Nil) (h₂ : 0 < p.darts.length) :
    p.firstDart h₁ = p.darts[0] := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.lastDart_eq
header:
theorem lastDart_eq {p : G.Walk v w} (h₁ : ¬ p.Nil) (h₂ : 0 < p.darts.length) :
    p.lastDart h₁ = p.darts[p.darts.length - 1] := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.head_darts_eq_firstDart
header:
theorem head_darts_eq_firstDart {p : G.Walk v w} (hnil : p.darts ≠ []) :
    p.darts.head hnil = p.firstDart (darts_eq_nil.not.mp hnil) := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.firstDart_eq_head_darts
header:
theorem firstDart_eq_head_darts {p : G.Walk v w} (hnil : ¬p.Nil) :
    p.firstDart hnil = p.darts.head (darts_eq_nil.not.mpr hnil) :=

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.head_darts_fst
header:
theorem head_darts_fst {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.darts ≠ []) :
    (p.darts.head hp).fst = a := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.firstDart_mem_darts
header:
theorem firstDart_mem_darts {p : G.Walk v w} (hnil : ¬p.Nil) : p.firstDart hnil ∈ p.darts :=
  p.firstDart_eq_head_darts _ ▸ List.head_mem _

@[simp]

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getLast_darts_eq_lastDart
header:
theorem getLast_darts_eq_lastDart {p : G.Walk v w} (hnil : p.darts ≠ []) :
    p.darts.getLast hnil = p.lastDart (darts_eq_nil.not.mp hnil) := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.lastDart_eq_getLast_darts
header:
theorem lastDart_eq_getLast_darts {p : G.Walk v w} (hnil : ¬p.Nil) :
    p.lastDart hnil = p.darts.getLast (darts_eq_nil.not.mpr hnil) := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getLast_darts_snd
header:
theorem getLast_darts_snd {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b) (hp : p.darts ≠ []) :
    (p.darts.getLast hp).snd = b := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.lastDart_mem_darts
header:
theorem lastDart_mem_darts {p : G.Walk v w} (hnil : ¬p.Nil) : p.lastDart hnil ∈ p.darts :=
  p.lastDart_eq_getLast_darts _ ▸ List.getLast_mem _

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.head_edges_eq_mk_start_snd
header:
theorem head_edges_eq_mk_start_snd {p : G.Walk v w} (hp) : p.edges.head hp = s(v, p.snd) := by

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.mk_start_snd_eq_head_edges
header:
theorem mk_start_snd_eq_head_edges {p : G.Walk v w} (hnil : ¬p.Nil) :

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.mk_start_snd_mem_edges
header:
theorem mk_start_snd_mem_edges {p : G.Walk v w} (hnil : ¬p.Nil) : s(v, p.snd) ∈ p.edges :=
  p.mk_start_snd_eq_head_edges hnil ▸ List.head_mem _

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.getLast_edges_eq_mk_penultimate_end
header:
theorem getLast_edges_eq_mk_penultimate_end {p : G.Walk v w} (hp) :

name: SimpleGraph.Walk.mk_penultimate_end_eq_getLast_edges
header:
theorem mk_penultimate_end_eq_getLast_edges {p : G.Walk v w} (hnil : ¬p.Nil) :
